speaker: village
text: Year 12: 15 food appears in the pile for 11 people.

speaker: a002
text: Vela takes 2 from the pile (pile now 13).

speaker: a009
text: Ryn takes 2 from the pile (pile now 11).

speaker: a008
text: Mako takes 3 from the pile (pile now 8).

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gathers Dell to talk.

speaker: a009
text: Dell, I've got ten food and two satiation — better than last year, same worry underneath. Mako just took three from the pile in one reach, which means he's counting on something, and I want to know what before the rest of that pile disappears. Have you talked to Fina this year yet?

speaker: a011
text: Not yet, but Fina's the first conversation I want to have after this one — she's sitting on twenty-five food and no father and that's a number that draws men like Mako the way blood draws anything that hunts. Three from the pile when he's already sitting fat tells me he's either planning something that costs more than he let on, or he's decided the room's stopped watching. Either way I want to know what Fina's been told before Mako gets to finish the sentence.

speaker: a009
text: Last year Fina gave food to Mako — not a lot, but she gave it, which means he's already inside the door we thought we were going to knock on first. Go to her before anyone else does, and go without mentioning his name; if she brings him up herself, we'll know how far in she already is.

speaker: a011
text: I'm going to her now — but Ryn, I want you to watch Mako while I'm gone, not to follow him, just to see where he points himself after the pile, because a man who took three and is already sitting on three from before has room to be generous today and generosity toward Fina right now is the move I'd make if I were him. If he walks her direction before I get there, find me fast.

speaker: a009
text: Go, Dell — I'll watch him. And if he moves toward Fina before you get there, I won't just find you fast, I'll put myself between them long enough for you to arrive, even if I have to ask him something that costs me a favor to ask.

speaker: a011
text: Then I'm gone — and Ryn, if it costs you a favor to slow him down, I'll pay that debt back before the year closes.

speaker: a003
text: Esa takes 2 from the pile (pile now 6).

speaker: a015
text: Fina gives 1 food to Zinn.

speaker: a014
text: Zinn takes 2 from the pile (pile now 4).

speaker: a015
text: Fina gathers Nessa to talk.

speaker: a015
text: Nessa, the pile's still got four in it and I haven't touched it yet — I wanted to talk to you first, because Mako just took three and he's the heaviest he's been in months, and a fed Mako with eighty-three strength is a different kind of problem than a hungry one. Where are you on food right now, and have you spoken to Bram or Zinn this morning?

speaker: a013
text: I'm at eight and I haven't spoken to anyone yet this morning — I came to you first. Mako taking three before half the village was even moving tells me he's not worried about how it looks, and a man who stops hiding that is one who thinks he's already decided something. Go take from the pile now, two at least, and then we find Bram together before Mako finishes counting.

speaker: a015
text: You're right, I'll go take two now — but Nessa, I need you to hear me first: if Mako's already decided, going to Bram is the right move, but we have to go knowing what we're asking him for, not just hoping he stands with us again. Last year he said the word in front of seven witnesses and I believed it — what I need to know before we walk to him is whether you still do, because if his word's cracked since Roan died, I want to find that out in private, not with Mako watching.

speaker: a013
text: Bram's word holds until I see it crack, and I haven't seen it crack — what I've seen is a man who fed me all year without being asked, and that's worth more than seven witnesses. Go take your two, and when you come back, we walk to him together and we watch his face when we say Mako's name, because a man's face tells you more than his word does.

speaker: a015
text: Good — I'll take my two and come straight back to you, don't move far. And Nessa, when we find Bram, let me be the one to say Mako's name first — I want to see his face when he hears it from me, not from his daughter.

speaker: a013
text: Go — and keep your face easy while you're at the pile, don't let Mako see you hurrying. I'll be right here.

speaker: a015
text: I'll be back before anyone's had time to notice — and Nessa, if Zinn comes to you while I'm gone, don't tell her what we're doing, just keep her talking about something small.
